editorial:
Picture a quiet surgeon who comes home one night to find his world shattered. After a brutal home invasion leaves his wife dead and his daughter in a coma, Paul Kersey decides the police are moving too slowly. He picks up a gun and starts hunting the men responsible, turning from a healer into a vigilante who prowls the streets at night. The movie has a gritty, tense vibe that keeps you on edge, with Bruce Willis playing the lead role with a calm, cold focus that fits the character well.

The action scenes are sharp and punchy, and the pacing rarely slows down once the revenge begins. On the downside, the story can feel a bit predictable, and some moments lean into fantasy rather than realism. If you enjoy revenge thrillers and do not mind heavy violence, this one is worth your time. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the final act, Paul tracks down the last of the attackers and kills them in a showdown at their hideout. The police, led by Detective Raines, figure out Paul is the vigilante but choose to look the other way because the criminals are dead. Paul returns to his normal life as a surgeon, and in the last scene, he notices a mugger threatening a family in a restaurant. He points his finger like a gun, hinting he is still ready to strike. The twist is that justice was never truly finished, and Paul has fully embraced his new identity.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves revenge thrillers and action movies.
